skills.name: Kindness
skills.text: Liu Bei's can give any number of his hand cards to any players. If he gives away more than one card, he recovers one unit of health.

skills.name: Fierce General
skills.text: King Ability: If Liu Bei needs to use an attack, he can ask any member of Shu to provide him one.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
